newsitem.title: PERU: Peru doctors tell Fujimori mouth tissue benign.
newsitem.headline: Peru doctors tell Fujimori mouth tissue benign.

text.p: The results of President Alberto Fujimori's oral surgery at Lima's top cancer hospital show the mouth tissue doctors operated on is benign, the Government Palace said on Tuesday.

"The conclusion of this analysis is a favorable diagnosis establishing that the studied tissue is benign," the palace said in a statement, after doctors from the National Institute of Neoplasmic Illnesses reported on Sunday's operation.
Fujimori, who held meetings with three of his ministers on Tuesday, would rest on Wednesday before returning fully to his official activities on Thursday, the statement added.
The 58-year-old president is set travel to Boston on Thursday to attend his eldest daughter Keiko's graduation ceremony.

Keiko, who has acted as Peru's first lady since Fujimori's split from his wife in 1995, said her father was not suffering from a serious illness and should be fully recovered from his operation within a week.
